_note: Scores, weighted score, hard fails and fixes as the craft judge returned them, round 1; each why abridged by the run.

criteria.name: artwork_craft
criteria.why: Bold register met; six or seven frames lean on a primitive model, a dead zone or an artifact: the cover's rounded boxes, 2's stub with a blank sign, 4's cut worker and shed, 5's flat band, 6's stock dashboards, 7's dot rig, 8's blinds, 9's toy rig.

criteria.name: deck_coherence
criteria.why: One world, one key, no strobe; motif and camera devices work; the reliefs read as different stock; the band drifts to tan on 9.

criteria.name: claim_integrity
criteria.why: Every numeral traces; 'now do much' firms c7; the caption quotes c3 while the first comment lists c1 c4 c5; frame 8's whole of 20 is not visible.

criteria.name: story_and_stakes
criteria.why: Who, when and where clear; a third of injuries is the stake; nothing to act on.

criteria.name: sequence_and_momentum
criteria.why: Hooks and pays; 4 and 5 make nearly one point; 7 a tangent.

criteria.name: voice
criteria.why: Good opener; 'Reuters reported' on five deks and 'drawn to illustrate' on three.

criteria.name: variety
criteria.why: 7's lateral, the racks on 8 and 9 and the worker by a gate repeat no. 68; ten of twenty for half repeats no. 69; the floodlit world repeats no. 67.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Clean rounded boxes, no die pads or loom, the pipe above a light column.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Jaw castings wrapping the joint with die inserts, a cable loom and grime, a mill scale pipe above with a specular line, tighter crop.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Worker cut at the shins, stand base hidden, an unplanned shed.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Lower and pull back so the worker stands whole beside the stand's base; delete the shed.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Blinds at 432 px; the rack runs off the bottom.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: All 20 joints and both beams between dek and footer, rotated a little, each casting a crescent.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Stock dashboards, speckled window, no operator.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A floor camera view on the screens, the lit floor and arm through the window, the operator's shoulder.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: The rig is a dot; strata uniform noise; hard seam.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A mast silhouette at scale, three or four distinct bands, feathered top edge.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: A stub over the slips, blank sign band, stray diagonal rail.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: A three-joint stand rising out of the top, remove the diagonal, letter or drop the band.

artwork_weakest_frames.problem: Toy rig, dead band, tan bands.
artwork_weakest_frames.fix: Closer camera on the rig floor; frame 5's ember paint on the bands.
